messages.author: 13904eb0f06097b0
messages.subject: Re: SpectronauttoMSstatsFormat() crashes with error 'old' is length 8 but 'new' is length 9
parts:
Hi Marek,

It appears from your data that there may be a couple problems.

First, I do not see which column should correspond to the Intensity. We expect there to be a PeakArea column which we use as protein intensity.

Second, you need to include an annotation file along with this file. The annotation file maps the runs to the condition and bioreplicate. As your condition in the data currently says "No Defined", we would not be able to tell what the experimental design is. There are a variety of resources for how to setup the annotation file, but I would still recommend looking at the end-to-end workflow vignette, which includes an example of what it should look like.

Devon

Do these columns need to be included in the Spectronaut output? Perhaps it is a question of Spectronaut settings. I'm guessing this is not the best forum to ask, if this is the case.

Devon
